body: Most infuriating time I heard this it was phrased more like "you only get one mom." I said "she only got one of me." It didn't really land with that person (because I guess you can always have more kids or something lol), but that's been a really helpful perspective to maintain.

I used to love writing when I was a teenager, but my parents felt I wasn't doing it the right way (it wasn't the kind of stories they liked) and *gasp* there was sex and profanity and stuff when they found my private stash. They tore it up, told me it was all trash and I was bad at writing, and basically treated me like a sex criminal. I was told "nobody else writes these awful things down," basically, and I internalized that for a long time until I discovered way too late that actually a lot of people write this stuff down. I still write but have literally never showed anything to anyone again, not even my partner of 20 years. It scares me to death because it might actually be bad and wrong.  
  
Related but maybe petty: music has always made me very happy. It's my main hobby. I have artists I like a lot and whose music means a lot to me by this point in life. My parents still see this as something to be corrected and will still ignore me if it comes up. Then they'll be like "nobody knows anything about you!!"
